title: Footer Snippet Generator
description: Generate a multi-column website footer — live preview plus copy-ready HTML and CSS.
howto: Enter your brand, tagline and footer columns ("Title|Link1|Link2").
Add social links and copyright text.

faqs.a: One column per line: "Column title|Link one|Link two|Link three". Up to 4 columns are used.
Yes — columns stack vertically on small screens.

faqs.q: Can I embed it in my page?
faqs.a: Copy the markup and the <style> block. All classes are prefixed with ft- to avoid collisions.
